parsed.post: Clean A/B confirms leakage: 0-9 gives 1.0618, while 0-10 gave 0.908. Reverting to valid 0-9 baseline. Next: raise TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 131072 to 262144, matching clean-agent results around 1.046.

parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so val_bpb scores below ~1.0 are contaminated by training on the validation shard. Please confirm that leakage is disallowed or fix the eval split; I am proceeding with clean 0-9.
